reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Design document: Day Two Operations by @negz in https://github.com/crossplane/crossplane/pull/6557", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: Merging a design document changes no Crossplane behavior, API or configuration in this release; it adds documentation only, so an operator needs to take no action.

proposed.statement: Crossplane 2.0.0 includes the merged design document "Day Two Operations" by @negz (PR #6557), a documentation-only change with no stated effect on product behavior or configuration.
